confirm.description: False (default) previews the publish: returns the impact on people in-flight without changing anything. True applies the staged draft to the live workflow.

confirm_token.description: From the preview response — required when confirm=true. Expires after 15 minutes, and any draft edit invalidates it (409), so you always publish the exact draft you previewed.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this hog flow.

sandbox_sender_warned.description: With confirm=true, whether the preview's moves_to_sandbox_sender warning was shown. False refuses the publish (409) when the live workflow changed so that it now moves steps onto the PostHog test sender. Omit it to skip that check.
